name: Mint Pocket Size Foldable Nursing Clipboard
seoTitle: Mint Pocket Nursing Clipboard with Cheat Sheets
metaDescription: A mint pocket size foldable nursing clipboard with three aluminum layers and cheat sheets, a fresh looking, budget friendly gift for nurses.
summary: A mint pocket size folding clipboard with nursing cheat sheets, a budget friendly gift that keeps report sheets tidy all shift.
whyItWorks: Scrub pockets are prime real estate, and anything that goes in them has to earn its spot. A pocket size clipboard does, because it replaces the folded paper report sheet that usually gets damp, torn, or lost by lunchtime. The three aluminum layers fold out to hold notes and reference sheets, then close back up when it is time to move.

Mint gives it a soft, fresh look that matches a lot of scrub colors and makes it easy to tell apart from everyone else's at the nurses station. It is a good fit for nurses on busy floors like med surg, where a full patient assignment means plenty to keep track of, and for students who are building their organization habits. Since it is budget friendly, it slides easily into a stocking, a Nurses Week basket, or a care package for someone starting a new job. Add a set of colored pens and a few blank report templates to make it ready on day one.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the cheat sheet topics before buying.
Confirm the folded dimensions if they wear slim fitting scrubs.
It pairs well with pens in matching colors.

faq.q: Will this fit in a scrubs pocket?
faq.a: It is sold as pocket size, but pocket depths vary. Check the folded measurements on the listing against their usual scrubs.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse who already has a clipboard?
faq.a: It can be if theirs is a flat board, since a folding version is easier to carry. If they already use one, a different gift may be better.
